title: The Subjunctive
subtitle: Wishes, commands, conditions, subordinate clauses.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The subjunctive mood expresses wishes, commands, purpose, result, and hypotheticals. Present subjunctive often identical to the infinitive stem: ic rīde (that I ride), hē rīde (that he ride). Past subjunctive uses the past plural stem: ic ride (if I rode), hē ride (if he rode). Common in subordinate clauses after þæt (that) and gif (if).
